summary: High Tide Inc., a Canadian cannabis retailer listed on Nasdaq/TSXV, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 22, 2026. The release reports third-party Rebel Thorn survey results showing Canna Cabana leading Canadian cannabis retail brand awareness at 36% versus 25% for the next retailer, plus a routine grant of 103,000 employee stock options exercisable at the prior TSXV closing price, vesting over two years. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are involved; the filing is an operational marketing update and equity-compensation notice, not a special situation.
